summary: A regulatory and market-focused day driven by e-commerce consumer protection rules, global bond yield pressures, and multiple IPO approvals reshaping India's fintech and retail landscape.

bullets.text: India tightens e-commerce rules with new consumer safeguards, directly impacting retail operations and compliance requirements.
US 10-year Treasury bonds hit 19-year high, reaching levels unseen since 2007 ahead of Fed rate decision, pressuring emerging market valuations.
Fibe secures Sebi approval for Rs 750 crore IPO with major VCs including TPG's Rise Fund selling shares in public offering.
India's consumer regulator escalates probe into Apple's software warranty terms, signaling tougher scrutiny on tech company practices.
Reliance Industries to sell 5-year bonds next week, signaling major capital market activity from India's largest conglomerate.
